Company: NextGen AI Platform
Role: Full Stack AI Engineer (Next.js & Python LLM Infrastructure)

Responsibilities:
- Develop full-stack generative AI web applications integrating Next.js 14, React, Tailwind CSS, and Python backend services.

- Design responsive, dark-mode user interfaces with micro-animations and real-time WebSocket state management.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of full-stack development experience with TypeScript, Next.js, React, and Python.
- Practical experience with OpenAI / Gemini APIs, LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Vector DBs.
- Proficiency in modern CSS, glassmorphic layout design systems, and frontend state optimization.
